description: A man with short dark hair, in a dark work coat and a worn leather apron, stands at a workbench adjusting a brass valve on a large cylindrical metal vessel wrapped in copper coils and piping. Glass flasks of amber liquid, a small gas flame under a glass jar, pressure gauges on the brick wall, and shelves of bottles fill the cluttered lab, with steam drifting through the air. Era cues are early twentieth-century: copper piping, brass fittings, dial gauges, glassware and a plain work coat. No legible letters, numbers or signature are visible, and the painting runs edge to edge with no frame or border.
